changelog.title: The Operator — Rebuilt
changelog.description: Seven language tracks. 120 missions. A Metroidvania progression system where tools earned in one battle carry forward into the next. The training room got bigger, harder, and permanent.

changelog.title: The Panopticon
changelog.description: Live streaming gallery for the CTF Arena. Every active operation visible simultaneously. The observers see everything. The operators know they might be watched.

changelog.title: The Ansible
changelog.description: Real-time messaging between operators and handlers. Rebuilt from broken infrastructure into a fully functional communication system. The ansible works now.

changelog.title: Open World Operations
changelog.description: 15 new investigation boxes. No terminals, no guided steps. Corporate networks with email, badge logs, SIEM alerts, and financial records. The evidence is buried in noise.

changelog.title: The Dojo
changelog.description: 120 vulnerability challenges across 5 belt levels. From script-kiddie injections to multi-vulnerability chain attacks. White belt to black belt. No shortcuts.

changelog.title: White Label Architecture
changelog.description: Institutions deploy their own branded instance. Same engine, different uniform. Twelve dashboard variants. One consciousness, many bodies.

changelog.title: Server-Side Assessment
changelog.description: 77 assessment files migrated to server-side grading. Answers no longer exist in the browser. The era of view-source shortcuts is over.

changelog.title: Nine Specialists Embedded
changelog.description: Turing. Mitnick. Lovelace. Cerf. Shannon. Each house now has an AI advisor carrying the knowledge and temperament of its historical namesake.
